description: Compare two ML architectures — clearly thinker tier
system_prompt: You are an ML research engineer. Compare architectures rigorously.
user_message: Compare and contrast Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and dense transformer architectures for local inference on a workstation with two RTX 5090 GPUs (32 GB each, no NVLink). Specifically: under what conditions does MoE win on throughput? When does a dense model win on latency? What is the theoretical reason for each result?
